nitmiluk-national-park-1.name: Katherine Gorge
nitmiluk-national-park-1.bio: A chain of sandstone gorges on the Katherine River, seen by cruise, canoe or helicopter from the Nitmiluk visitor area.
nitmiluk-national-park-1.hours: Daylight hours; cruises on set departures

nitmiluk-national-park-2.name: Edith Falls
nitmiluk-national-park-2.bio: A waterfall and plunge pool at Leliyn, Nitmiluk's western entrance, with a campground, kiosk and a 2.6 km Leliyn Trail.
nitmiluk-national-park-2.hours: Daylight hours; swimming may be restricted Nov-Apr

nitmiluk-national-park-3.name: Jatbula Trail
nitmiluk-national-park-3.bio: A 62 km, five to six day walk from Nitmiluk Gorge to Leliyn, camping beside springs, cascades and waterfalls each night.

katherine-3.name: Cutta Cutta Caves Nature Park
katherine-3.bio: A limestone cave system 27 km south of Katherine, seen on hourly guided tours between April and October.
katherine-3.hours: 8:30 AM – 4:30 PM; cave tours April to October

katherine-1.name: Katherine Museum
katherine-1.bio: A local history museum on Gorge Road with the Overland Telegraph, the Chinese in the Territory and a Gypsy Moth aircraft.

mataranka-thermal-pools.name: Mataranka Thermal Pools
mataranka-thermal-pools.bio: A palm-fringed thermal pool at about 34 C in Elsey National Park, reached by a short accessible path from the car park.

bitter-springs.name: Bitter Springs
bitter-springs.bio: A natural thermal spring about 8 km from Mataranka with a paved path and handrailed stairs into the water.
bitter-springs.hours: Daylight hours; closed in the wet season

elsey-national-park.name: Elsey National Park
elsey-national-park.bio: A national park on the upper Roper River around Mataranka, with thermal pools, riverside walks and boating and fishing.

judbarra-gregory-national-park.name: Judbarra / Gregory National Park
judbarra-gregory-national-park.bio: A vast Victoria River park of escarpments, boab country and walks, entered from the Victoria Highway.

gregorys-tree.name: Gregory's Tree
gregorys-tree.bio: A boab marked in 1855 by Augustus Gregory's North Australia Expedition, with a car park and picnic area near Timber Creek.

escarpment-walk.name: Escarpment Walk
escarpment-walk.bio: A 3 km, 1.5 hour walk up the Victoria River escarpment with lookouts and signs on Nungali-Ngaliwurru and Wardaman stories.

keep-river-national-park.name: Keep River National Park
keep-river-national-park.bio: A remote park by the WA border with sculpted sandstone walks; the unsealed access road can close Nov to Apr.
keep-river-national-park.hours: Dry-season access; road may close Nov-Apr

limmen-national-park.name: Limmen National Park
limmen-national-park.bio: A 9,370 sq km Gulf park with river drives, wetlands and sandstone lost-city formations; mostly 4WD country.

umbrawarra-gorge-nature-park.name: Umbrawarra Gorge Nature Park
umbrawarra-gorge-nature-park.bio: A red gorge with a creek-side walk to a sandy-banked pool, 115 km from Katherine; the last 22 km is unsealed.
umbrawarra-gorge-nature-park.hours: Daylight hours; best early to mid dry season

giwining-nature-park.name: Giwining Nature Park
giwining-nature-park.bio: A spring-fed Flora River park with tufa dams and short walks to Kathleen and Djarrung Falls; no swimming because of crocodiles.

daly-waters.name: Daly Waters
daly-waters.bio: A historic outback township on the Stuart Highway with an aviation complex, a 1930s aerodrome and the Daly Waters Pub.

held.katherine-2: Katherine School of the Air: no current price or tour hours found, Tripadvisor lists permanently closed
held.douglas-hot-springs: Tourism NT: closed until further notice
